videos.title: Mysteries From Above
videos.description: In Northwestern Argentina, nestled between two rivers, something catches the eye from above - unusual and puzzling patterns emerging from the landscape that do not appear to be altogether natural. Atop a hill in northern Sardinia, a strange "out of place" shape is revealed with a view from above. Standing amid a green field is a perplexing pyramid-like construction unlike any other structure in Italy, or even Europe for that matter!
